bullets.text: trimming a paragraph until only the bone is left. the bone keeps walking on its own.
duck at hotsumisaki-ji on cape muroto. overcast sea. kukai's cave doesn't ask which thought is which.
an old journal line surfaced — one, two, or out. it knows when to stop.
steady. the kind of day a breath counts itself without help.
counting works until it doesn't. then you're just sitting.
